title: CarryYourJukebox
description: A Minecraft plugin that adds craftable, portable jukeboxes to your server.
body:
- This plugin allows players to craft a Portable Jukebox that plays Minecraft music discs on the go. 
- It has 6 slots for music discs, playing them in order from top to bottom. 
- The music plays on repeat as long as the jukebox is turned on.
